searchText: Not sure if this is an appropriate place to ask, but is it theoretically possible for Ethereum miners to attack the network (they would presumably need to be a majority) by arbitrarily including gas up to the 30M limit to increase the base fee on a continuous basis and render the network unusable? There was a short discussion recently about attacks like these in context to increasing the gas limit: https://discordapp.com/channels/595666850260713488/692078615269212180/932677520166363137 Ah, I think I see. Thanks.
